integrity: The all-order result is proved combinatorially by an exact cut/valley equivalence and interval hitting. The embedded verifier independently exhausts all 46,233 edge-time permutations through nine vertices, brute-forces seed sets, and checks the hitting formula; finite computation is used only as a stress test, not as the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to temporal paths with one activation per edge and pairwise distinct activation times under synchronous snapshot zero forcing. It does not cover tied times, repeated activations, or nonpath graphs. A separately archived project advertises exact alternating-path results, but its full manuscript was not available from the inspected public endpoint, so exact overlap on that special subclass remains a residual literature risk.
title: Local maxima determine temporal zero forcing on injectively timed paths
